title: Maximum Subarray (Kadane's Algorithm)
question: How do you find the maximum sum subarray in an array containing negative numbers? Explain Kadane's algorithm.
realWorldScenario: Track maxEndingHere and maxSoFar; reset maxEndingHere to 0 when it goes negative. O(n) single pass.

title: Jump Game — Can You Reach End
question: Given an array where each element is the max jump length, how do you determine if you can reach the last index?
realWorldScenario: Track the maximum reachable index as you iterate — greedy O(n) approach.

title: Buy and Sell Stock
question: How do you find the maximum profit from one buy and one sell of stock given daily prices?
searchIntent: best time to buy sell stock java interview
realWorldScenario: Track the minimum price seen so far and compute profit = currentPrice - minPrice at each step. O(n).

title: Find Kth Largest Element
question: How do you find the Kth largest element in an unsorted array in Java?
realWorldScenario: Min-heap of size K: iterate array, add each element; when size > K pop the min. Final heap top is Kth largest.

title: Merge Intervals
question: How do you merge overlapping intervals in Java?
realWorldScenario: Sort intervals by start time, then merge if current start <= previous end. O(n log n).

title: Rotate Image Matrix
question: How do you rotate an n×n matrix by 90 degrees clockwise in-place in Java?
realWorldScenario: Transpose the matrix (swap [i][j] and [j][i]), then reverse each row. O(n²) time O(1) space.

title: Spiral Matrix Traversal
question: How do you traverse a matrix in spiral order in Java?
realWorldScenario: Use four boundary pointers (top, bottom, left, right) that shrink as each layer is printed.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
question: How do you find the length of the longest consecutive sequence in an unsorted array in O(n)?
realWorldScenario: Add all elements to a HashSet, then for each number that is a sequence start (num-1 not in set), expand rightward. O(n).
